# Three.js

Unmodified ESM builds and MIT license from the official [three@0.187.0 npm release](https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.187.0). The browser imports these files on demand for the street view. Vendoring lets Counterfolk run on GitHub Pages and offline without a build step or CDN.
